history.name: One command that says whether the record is sound
history.description: `ledger check` reads the whole record and reports on it: it fails on anything that would make a document wrong or unbuildable, and warns about everything that is valid but would print badly. It is the one thing to run before finishing a piece of work, and it gives a plain summary — how many features, areas and releases there are, and which release is open — when all is well.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/build.mjs — cmdCheck. Loading the project runs every structural validation; check adds the shape rules as errors and the presentation problems as warnings. Exits non-zero on any failure, so it works as a commit hook.
